ctx.x: Well, Herman, where shall we place Emmett Hardy in relation to Bix?

Emmett Hardy, John, that's something I have heard of. I've often wondered about it. How can you tell? What can you say? I didn't know him. No one had a recording of him, did they? I don't think so, did they? I never found him. They said, Monk Hazel said there was a cylinder disc that was made of him, but no one has ever really found it.
